rows.en:
In that case…

to start with, let us capture Rieko and make her tell us where the children with the blueprints are.
What do you think of this Android Akira?

Hmm… The outside looks fine!

Make it walk!
The sound of its steps and its movements still feel like an android! Work on it some more!
Understood… It's no trouble at all, Shadow Knight…
Akira! Akira!
Rieko! What's wrong!?
Jiro! Please save Akira! He fell into the sea!

…!? Akira!

Toh…!

Heh heh, you fool! You don't even know that Akira is an android…

That android is rigged to explode the moment Zero-One or Kikaider lays a hand on it!
Akiraaaa! Jirooooo!
Where is she? Where?
Shadow scum! I'll rescue Akira and Jiro myself! I won't let you lay a finger on Rieko!
Ichiro!
Rieko, it's dangerous! Stay hidden!
Akira, you're safe!?
Akira!

Akira, thank goodness…

…!?

This feel…!?
…!? Ichirooooo!

Hahaha… We did it! At last we've disposed of the Kikaiders!

Take the woman away!
Hold it! I won't let you do that!
Fool… I'm not so weak that a mere human can beat me!

Taaah! Ohohohohoho…

Wherever there are flowers in this world, I dance out from among them to stand against evil!
Nngh, Bijinder! You traitor!
Out of my way!
Uwaaaah…
…!? Taki!
Bijinder! I'm taking the woman!
Kyah…
Rieko!
No good! It looks like we were a step too late.
[HERO2], [HERO4]!

Takiii!

Bijinder, is Taki all right?

…………

He's dead.
Agh… Aaah…
Stubborn woman… Will you still not tell us where Akira and Hiroshi are?
Ngh… I can't tell you… what I don't know!

Hmph… Does she know or doesn't she?

Call up Gill on Black Satan and have him talk with this woman!
Professor Gill! Show yourself on the screen!
…Shut up, you robots! Want to borrow my wisdom again, do you?

…!?

Professor… Gill!
Professor Gill! You know this woman, don't you?

Rieko…!?

She's the woman I left Akira with…
Then this woman… also knows where the other child is?
You mean his older brother, Hiroshi?
Hiroshi…? Is that his name? Where is he?
Hiroshi is with a woman called Misao, at a certain place here in Japan…
And where is this "certain place"?
Heh heh heh… That I can't tell anyone.
Tell us, and we'll spare your sons' lives! All we want is…

The blueprints hidden on their backs…? You blockhead!

If I could hand them over so easily… do you think I'd have hidden them on my children's bodies!?

Blast it!

Then… we'll extract the information on Hiroshi and Misao from Gill's memory cells!

…!?

Stop it! Stooop!
Heh heh heh… With Black Satan, it's simple! Hahaha…
Oyassan, how's it going?
It's been a good three hours now since Mari went into that room…
I guess it's impossible after all, huh? Bringing a dead man back to life…
No… It's too early to give up! I'm sure Mari will…
But… I wonder if Mari can hold out that long?
What do you mean, [HERO4]?

There's only one way to revive Taki now that his heart has stopped…

And that's to give him shock treatment using almost all of Bijinder's energy.

And if it fails, Mari could lose her life too.
What!? Then…
Mari…!?
It… didn't work?
Uuugh… Taki will be back on his feet in about an hour.
Mari… You've used up all your energy…!?
Ugh… Please, keep what I did a secret from Taki.
Mari! Where do you think you're going in that state? You need to rest a little…

We have to rescue Ichiro and Jiro… and Rieko too!

I'll be all right. My energy will recover soon…
Mari…

Jeez, what the heck is going on?

Thanks to Mari, it looks like Taki'll pull through somehow, but he's got near-fatal injuries… and Ichiro and Jiro have gone missing?
At this rate… Akira, Akira's big brother… and Misao are in danger too!

Lady Bijinder… I would have you tell me.

Why did you save that young man, even at the cost of all your own energy?
Saving human lives is an android's duty… That is all.
Nay, that is not it… You too, my lady, are in love with that young man!
Waruder… I am an android, and Taki is human! Never in a million years would I…

Enough… I will not hear clumsy excuses!

If you insist that it is not love, then I challenge you, my lady, to a duel here and now!

uncertain: U09865/U09867: Rieko calls Akira "Akira-chan"; dropped -chan. Akira is a boy (glossary).
U09872: Shadowman is searching for someone; "she" (Rieko) inferred from U09873.
U09878: Ichiro touches the android Akira and recognizes the feel; "This feel…!?" kept vague as in the Japanese.
U09911: "your sons" - Shadow Knight assumes Akira and Hiroshi are Gill's sons.
U09918: 死んだ人間 rendered "a dead man" since it refers to Taki.
U09934-U09938: Waruder's archaic samurai speech (ご貴殿, 拙者, ござらん) rendered as old-fashioned English; ご貴殿 as "my lady".
omissions_kept: U09925: subject of "didn't work" left implied (the revival).
